en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town with a narrow dirt road in the foreground where several children walk carrying buckets. Wooden fences enclose gardens and orchards. On the right is a multi‑story stucco house with dormer windows and patterned roof tiles; laundry hangs on lines in the yards. To the left stands a timber‑framed house. In the background rises a large Gothic‑revival church with a tall, slender spire and multiple smaller towers, surrounded by dense townhouses and ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. The scene feels rural‑urban, calm, and domestic. No clear printed caption is visible.
